_comment: AGENTS.md 'Drift watchlist' as enforced code — architecture-hardening.md R1. Every PERMITTED same-logic-in->=2-places duplicate in this repo is enumerated here with its copies (file + a regex that must still match there) and its lock (the fixture/generated-file/test that catches drift, or 'unlocked' when none exists yet). scripts/drift-check.mjs (just check-drift / just check) enforces: (a) every copy exists where claimed, (b) every declared lock file exists and lockStatus is consistent with whether locks are registered, (c) for entries with a 'scan' block, no NEW file outside the registered copies matches the concept's detection pattern. Registration friction is the feature — do not add entries for concepts that haven't actually drifted or burned us; do not delete an entry because its pattern is inconvenient, tighten the pattern instead. Each concept is one file under scripts/drift-registry/, named for the concept and listed in entryFiles below; a file there that is not listed fails the gate.
